world.title: Argentine VP calls England ‘pirates’ ahead of World Cup semifinal clash
world.summary: Argentina's Vice President Victoria Villarruel referred to England as "usurping pirates" in a statement before the World Cup semifinal match between the two nations. Her comments highlight ongoing tensions related to sovereignty disputes. Villarruel emphasized the significance of the game, stating, “We play against the usurping pirates. It’s not just another match,” in a post on X.

world.title: British Sikh woman stabbed to death in London, 44-year-old suspect arrested
world.summary: Kirandeep Kaur, a 24-year-old British Sikh woman, was fatally stabbed in Hayes, west London. A man in his 20s sustained injuries during the incident. The Metropolitan Police responded alongside the London Ambulance Service. Daniel Sean James, a 44-year-old suspect, has been arrested and faces multiple charges related to the stabbing. Investigations are ongoing.

world.title: 'No plans for talks with US right now': Iran shuts door on immediate negotiations after fresh American strikes
world.summary: Iran has announced it has no plans for immediate negotiations with the United States amid escalating tensions and fighting between the two nations. Tehran accuses Washington of violating a recent interim agreement. The Iranian government emphasized that its primary focus is on national defense, indicating a firm stance against engaging in talks with the US at this time.

business.title: Flights Cancelled Sweeping Saudi Arabia As Riyadh, Jeddah, Abha, Gizan, And Sharurah Cancel 208 And Delay 150 Flights, Grounding Saudia, Etihad, And Others
business.summary: Flight disruptions in Saudi Arabia affected thousands as over 350 flights were canceled or delayed, primarily in Riyadh, Jeddah, Abha, Gizan, and Sharurah. A total of 208 flights were canceled and 150 delayed due to heightened security concerns in the southern region. Abha Airport faced the most significant impact, grounding major airlines including Saudia and Etihad.

business.title: Russia seeks more petrol from India as Ukrainian strikes cripple oil refineries
business.summary: Russia has sought increased petrol supplies from Indian refiners, including discussions with companies like Rosneft, Gazprom Neft, and Lukoil. This request follows significant disruptions to Russia's oil refining capabilities due to recent Ukrainian strikes. The outreach signifies a notable shift in the energy relationship between Russia and India, involving both private and government-owned refiners in the discussions.

business.title: EPFO interest credit begins: How members can check if the amount is credited to their accounts
business.summary: EPFO members can check their accounts for the annual interest of 8.25% for FY2025-26 starting July 15. The retirement fund body has begun crediting this interest to members' provident fund accounts. To verify the credited amount, members can access their PF balance online through the EPFO portal or mobile app, ensuring they stay informed about their savings.

technology.title: Lomography's New Half Frame Camera Promises 'Double the Fun, Twice the Photos'
technology.summary: Lomography has introduced the Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Half Frame, designed to take half-frame photos, effectively doubling the number of shots per 35mm film roll. This new camera offers a more economical option compared to traditional models, appealing to both casual and serious photographers. The product aims to enhance the film photography experience by maximizing shooting potential.

technology.title: Google vs. Epic is finally over, and third-party app stores are coming
technology.summary: Starting July 22, third-party app stores will be allowed within Google Play in the US, enabling users to download them like regular apps. These stores will feature pre-stocked listings from Google Play unless developers choose to opt out. This change is limited to the US, as third-party app stores will still face restrictions outside the country.

technology.title: Third-party app stores will soon be available through the Google Play Store in the US
technology.summary: Google will soon allow third-party app stores through the Google Play Store in the US, following a legal resolution with Epic Games. For other regions, Google is introducing its Registered App Store program. This move reflects the company's shift in policy regarding app distribution, acknowledging the profitability of app stores while adapting to legal and market pressures.

sports.title: England vs Argentina, FIFA World Cup LIVE updates: Gordon breaks deadlock with long-awaited goal
sports.summary: In the FIFA World Cup 2026 semifinal between England and Argentina, Anthony Gordon scored the opening goal, breaking the deadlock. The match featured several substitutions, including Nicolás Otamendi and Gonzalo Montiel for Argentina, and Ezri Konsa for England. Live updates are being provided by The Hindu as the teams compete for a place in the final.

sports.title: ICC unveils new formats for Men's ODI and T20 World Cup
sports.summary: The ICC has announced significant changes to the formats of the Men's ODI and T20 World Cups. The new structure includes two groups of six teams, with the top three from each group and one additional team advancing to a round-robin Super 7 stage. This aims to enhance the number of meaningful matches in these prestigious tournaments.

sports.title: Michael Olise wants Real Madrid! Bayern Munich star ready to push for big transfer to unite with France co-star Kylian Mbappe
sports.summary: Michael Olise, currently a winger at Bayern Munich, is eager to join Real Madrid this summer, aiming to reunite with France teammate Kylian Mbappe. Despite a hefty €200 million asking price, Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho has expressed strong interest in acquiring Olise. Reports indicate that Olise is actively pushing for the transfer during the current window.

health.title: NPPA Caps Retail Price of Calcium and Vitamin D3 Tablets at Rs 8.93
health.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has set the retail price of Calcium and Vitamin D3 Tablets IP at Rs 8.93. This decision is in accordance with the Drugs (Prices Control) Order (DPCO), 2013. The price adjustment aims to regulate the cost of these essential supplements, ensuring affordability for consumers while adhering to government pricing regulations.

health.title: Before you scratch that mosquito bite, try this warm spoon method
health.summary: A viral remedy for mosquito bites involves using a warm spoon to provide temporary itch relief. Dermatologists suggest that controlled heat can calm the nerves that trigger itching, offering comfort for some bites. However, this method is not a cure, and excessive heat can lead to skin burns. Caution is advised when using this technique for relief.

health.title: WHO Begins Clinical Trial of Gilead's Obeldesivir Against Bundibugyo Ebola
health.summary: The World Health Organization has initiated a clinical trial to evaluate the antiviral drug obeldesivir against the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Named EBO-PEP, the trial focuses on post-exposure prophylaxis for individuals who have been in contact with confirmed Ebola cases. The oral medication aims to determine its effectiveness in preventing the disease.

science.title: Breakthrough Study Uncovers New Evidence Connecting “Hidden" Dimensions to Mystery of Dark Matter
science.summary: New research suggests connections between dark matter and a potential hidden fifth dimension, addressing one of the universe's enduring mysteries. Dark matter, a crucial component in several cosmological theories, remains largely undetectable. This study aims to deepen understanding of dark matter's properties and its relationship with dimensions beyond the familiar four, potentially reshaping current astrophysical models.

science.title: Tectonic forces may explain why Antarctica is covered in ice
science.summary: Scientists have discovered that ancient tectonic activity significantly altered Antarctica's landscape, contributing to the formation of its vast ice sheet millions of years later. Originally, Antarctica was a warm, humid region teeming with life. Approximately 34 million years ago, tectonic changes initiated a dramatic climate shift, leading to the onset of glaciation and the icy conditions observed today.

science.title: Raspberry sugar spotted in interstellar space, a sweet discovery that could reveal clues about life's origins
science.summary: Astronomers have discovered a sugar compound called erythrulose in interstellar space, specifically near the center of the Milky Way galaxy. This sugar is chemically similar to that found in raspberries. The discovery may provide insights into the origins of life, as it suggests that complex organic molecules can form in space, potentially contributing to the building blocks of life.

entertainment.title: BREAKING: 4-minute-15-second-long trailer of Ramayana passed by CBFC with a ‘U’ certificate
entertainment.summary: The Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) has approved a 4-minute-15-second trailer for the upcoming film "Ramayana," granting it a 'U' certificate. This certification indicates the trailer is suitable for all audiences. The release of the trailer is highly anticipated, generating significant excitement among fans and the Bollywood community ahead of its debut.

entertainment.title: Shilpa Shinde reveals she faced harassment after quitting Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain, was threatened with a fake MMS; 'Bhabhiji Ka MMS Out'
entertainment.summary: Shilpa Shinde, a participant in the reality show Lock Upp: Sach Yaa Sazaa, revealed she experienced harassment after leaving Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain. She reported being threatened with a fake MMS, which added to her distress. Shinde discussed these challenges during a conversation with fellow contestant Varun Yadav, highlighting the difficulties she faced post-departure from the show.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for July 16, 2026
entertainment.summary: Daily horoscope predictions for July 16, 2026, are available, detailing astrological events and influences affecting each of the 12 zodiac signs. An astrologer has analyzed planetary movements and alignments to provide insights into how these celestial factors may impact individuals. Readers can explore personalized forecasts based on their zodiac signs to understand potential influences on their day.
